outsideRules.group: What happened broke a rule of the advisor, so the order cannot be scored. This list is where a wrong rule or a wrong stock figure shows first. These orders are a group of their own: never "another plan", and never counted against a set.

reasons.NO_STOCK: The stock figure could not cover the line, by Dawaa Now
reasons.OUT_OF_REACH: A store out of reach for the mode
reasons.NO_STOCK_ROW: A pair with no stock row
reasons.BOOK_NEVER_HELD: The store’s book has never held this item
reasons.NOT_MODE_STORE: A store that does not serve the mode
reasons.CLOSED_NOW: A store closed at the time

says.NO_STOCK: Dawaa Now holds the stock filter at the named store too, so a Dawaa Now line on a short figure is outside the rules.
says.OUT_OF_REACH: Routing sent the order to a store farther than the mode reaches: moved by hand, or chosen by a call-centre agent.
says.PRODUCT_RULE: An item went by a mode its product rule keeps it off: a cold, bulky or restricted item.
says.NO_STOCK_ROW: The store has no stock row for the item, so the advisor removes the pair in every mode.
says.BOOK_NEVER_HELD: The store’s book has never held this item: a mistake of the book or of the routing.
says.NOT_MODE_STORE: The store is not on the mode’s list of stores.
says.MODE_OFF: The mode was switched off when the order landed.
says.CLOSED_NOW: The store was closed when the order landed.
says.PAST_CUTOFF: The order landed after the store’s cutoff for the mode.
says.NO_SLOT: The store had no slot left to offer.
says.other: A reason the page has no words for yet; its code is shown as sent.

outsideRules.barLabel: {{reason}}: {{percent}} of the orders outside the advisor’s rules
outsideRules.note: A reason on more than 1% of orders needs a written ruling before the phase 2 bar is met.

distance.expressStamp: The express stamp (came in + 45 minutes) was met by <p/>.
distance.note: One margin per mode cannot mend a promise that is right overall and wrong at one distance.

stock.title: Stock check
stock.lede: Every real delivery is read at its own store, whatever the plan said. A no-stock ending on a delivery the run called covered is one failed pick.

cols.read: What the run’s stock read said of the delivery

stock.coveredLong: Covered: the store showed at least the units asked
stock.thin: Only store tills send a reason, since mid-November: most cancellations carry none, so these counts are thin.
stock.figureNoStock: Stock check: {{read}}, ended for no stock

shelf.title: The shelf chance table, with its evidence
shelf.bold: Bold: the chance in the table of <set/>, version <version/>, that the shelf holds fewer units than asked.
shelf.picksLine: Under it: failed lines of covered lines on real deliveries in this period, their share, and how the figure stands against them.
shelf.halvesLine: Under it: what full counts found in each of the last three half-years: <h1/>, <h2/> and <h3/>.
shelf.tooFewRule: "Too few" stands where the figure expects under 50 failed lines. A figure may change when it expects at least 50 failed lines on one-line deliveries, the gap is beyond chance and both halves of the window agree; a person reads this before saving a new version of the table.
shelf.leftOverTitle: Units left over (the units the store shows less the units asked)
shelf.fleetRatio: Fleet ratio (failed lines against what the table expected):
shelf.window: The table is read from <counts/> full counts, from <from/> to <to/>.

rows.title: The eight short-figure rows, from deliveries
rows.note: A line in a larger basket fails less, so a ratio well under 1 on every delivery is expected. A row is judged on its one-line ratio, and about 0.9 there is a row that fits.

cols.row: Stock class at the named store
cols.groups: Lines behind both, per channel group

laterSlots.sentence: orders ( of orders with a slot delivery) had a later slot that the weight set’s slot timing table prices lower than the earliest. In the middle order the cheaper slot started minutes after the earliest.
laterSlots.sentenceNoMiddle: orders ( of orders with a slot delivery) had a later slot that the weight set’s slot timing table prices lower than the earliest.
laterSlots.note: Every plan keeps the earliest slot Hybris offers. This count changes no plan, and it is read, never a limit. The figures compare customers who chose a later slot, not customers moved to one.
